text:
ana: Heads-up: quick sync tomorrow 3pm PT to reconcile vendor ETA slates for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Focus: embargo windows, driver pin, and SI integration handoffs.

vik: calendar invite out. agenda: 1) firmware freeze dates 2) SI cert milestones 3) marketplace SKU mapping 4) power/thermal constraints for EU regions

peter: from eng-sre, note that EU racks have a steady-state power cap lower than US. MI300 sustained runs pushed us into thermal derate last month. we should flag region-specific quotas.

lina: labs update: west-2 cluster free Mon-Tue next week. can host multi-node MI300 runs but need vendor canaries by Fri EOD.

vendor-bot: Latest tags: mi300-fw-2024-04-02, gaudi-driver-v1.8.0, h100-fw-2024-03-29, b200-image:v20240403.

ana: typo above, meant ana. can we have SI leads attend? integration points are the long poles.

vik: invited SI leads (glen). Glen, can you confirm SI onboarding readiness and test harness requirements?

glen: SI checklist: image signing, network peering test, perf regression harness, automation for model flipover. we need sample infra-as-code snippets from redwood to validate VPC peering.

peter: sharing a short stress script below we use for regional derate detection. please run on canary images.

```
stress.sh
#!/bin/bash
# quick stress runner for long-sequence workload
for i in {1..8}; do
  ./run_model --model=gptx-large --seq=4096 --batch=1 --device=$i --tokens=200000
done
```

lina: vendor-bot  can you confirm whether H200 images include updated thermal counters? we need high-frequency sampling for trace correlation.

vendor-bot: H200 images include thermal-exporter v0.3. Sampling configurable to 50ms. Image tag: h200/canary:v20240405.

ana: product note: marketplace listing must include supported max tokens and recommended quantization presets. otherwise customers will mis-target. Can we add those fields to the SKU metadata schema?

vik: yes, add fields: max_seq, recommended_q, fallback_model_tag. we'll share schema PR after the call.

ana: for public announcements, marketing wants a 7-day embargo buffer after driver freeze to prepare docs. vendors, please confirm driver freeze date.

glen: SI risk: if firmware slips >5 days we will need to extend SI dry-run or scope to core flows only.

vik: propose coordination timeline (rough):
- H100/B200: canary Apr 4-5 -> driver freeze Apr 7 -> marketplace preview Apr 15 -> public Apr 22
- H200: canary Apr 6-7 -> extended perf Apr 8-12 -> driver freeze Apr 14 -> preview Apr 22 -> public Apr 30
- MI300/Gaudi: canary Apr 10-14 -> perf validation Apr 15-21 -> driver freeze Apr 22 -> preview Apr 29 -> public May 6

peter: H200 schedule still risky because of derate analysis. ask partners if they can provide a thermals+power patch to reduce throttling.

lina: labs will reserve windows but require signed canary images 48h prior.

ana: action items: 1) vendors confirm freeze tags (vendors) 2) SI provide infra snippets and risk matrix (glen) 3) perf team run regional stress on canaries (peter) 4) marketplace schema PR (vik) 5) marketing embargo buffer acknowledgement (ana)

vendor-bot: Reminder: meeting link https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/1709521122.

glen: ACK + will share IaC snippets in the call notes.

ana: please reply in-thread with "ACK + firmware tag" so we can drive the checklist. I'll post minutes after sync. :white_check_mark:
